Title: An Adaptive Training System for Mandarin Tones Learning Based on Performance Factors Analysis Difficulty Model


Researchers: Meng Cao, The University of Memphis, Email: mcao@memphis.edu, Phone: 901-281-7348.
Philip Pavlik (faculty advisor), The University of Memphis, Email: ppavlik@memphis.edu, Phone: 901-678-2326.


You are being asked to participate in a research study. The content below highlights key information for you to consider when deciding if you want to participate. Please ask the researcher(s) any questions about the study before you make your decision. If you volunteer, you will be one of about 200 people to do so. You will consent by pressing a button at the bottom of the page.


Key Information for You to Consider

It is up to you whether you choose to participate or not. There will be no penalty or loss of benefit to which you are otherwise entitled if you choose not to participate or discontinue participation.


Purpose: The experiment is designed to evaluate the effectiveness of an adaptive training system on tone learning. We will compare it with a non-adaptive training method that selects items randomly for practice.


Duration: It is expected that your participation will last about 1 hour in one session depending on the time you spend on the tests.


Requirement: In order to ensure the audio input quality, you are required to wear your headphones when doing the task.


Procedures and Activities: You will be randomly selected for one of 2 conditions with different training algorithms if you choose to participate. One condition will adjust the difficulty of items according to your performance during the learning session. The other one will just randomly select the items for practice. Whatever condition you are in, you will need to do a pre-test first, then a learning session, a posttest, and answer some survey questions finally. Please follow the directions and try to do your best. Your performance in the whole experiment will correlate with the amount of payment you received.

Compensation: You will get a base amount of $7 for the entire session and a bonus of $.01 per correct answer in the pre-test, learning session, and posttest. For example, if you get 200 correct answers, you will receive $9 ($7 + $.01*200).


Risk: The possible risks of this study are minimal. Besides typical risks present from sitting in front of a computer (e.g. eyestrain and auditory fatigue) and possibly boredom, you may experience temporary frustration or confusion. There is only a minimal probability that these risks will occur.


Benefits: You could acquire the knowledge about Mandarin tones by participating. The results of this research could lead to suggestions for real-world implementation of adaptive tone training.


For questions regarding the research subjects' rights, the Chair of the Institutional Review Board for the Protection of Human Subjects should be contacted at 901-678-2705 or email irb@memphis.edu.


All efforts, within the limits allowed by law, will be made to keep the personal information (your Amazon Turk Worker ID) in your research record private but total privacy cannot be promised. We will deidentify your data (remove your ID) after the experiment before storing it on our computers long-term. By participating, you understand and agree that the deidentified data gathered during this study may be used by the University of Memphis and published and/or disclosed by University of Memphis to others outside of University of Memphis. However, no personally identifying information will ever be mentioned in any such publication or dissemination of the research data and/or results to other researchers.


Note that Amazon.com has stated that the MTurk platform is NOT meant to support participant anonymity. MTurk worker IDs are linked to Amazon.com public profiles. Amazon.com may disclose worker information. Additionally, worker information may be available to others (who submit a request) for tax reporting purposes.


By clicking this continue button, I consent to the above terms.

First, please put on your headphones.

In the beginning of this experiment, you will be presented with a figure showing the pitch contours of Chinese (Mandarin) 4 tones which could help you learn the tones. Please pay attention to the pitch pattern of each tone. After this, you will be showed tone samples for the syllable ma.

Please press the CONTINUE button below.
Below is a figure showing the pitch contours of the tones. Please wait for a few seconds if it does not appear immediately.

Tone 1 is a high level tone . Below is a figure showing the pitch pattern of this tone. Click the CONTINUE button to hear two examples of Tone 1 carried by syllable ma. We are using level (-) to describe the phonetic feature of the tone. Please listen carefully to the syllable and try to identify the tone to continue. There will be feedback about your answer.

Tone 2 is a rising tone . Below is a figure showing the pitch pattern of this tone. Click the CONTINUE button to hear two examples of Tone 2 carried by syllable ma. We are using rising (/) to describe the phonetic feature of the tone. Please listen carefully to the syllable and try to identify the tone to continue. There will be feedback about your answer.

Tone 3 is a falling-rising tone . Below is a figure showing the pitch pattern of this tone. Click the CONTINUE button to hear two examples of Tone 3 carried by syllable ma. We are using dipping (\/) to describe the phonetic feature of the tone. Please listen carefully to the syllable and try to identify the tone to continue. There will be feedback about your answer.

Tone 4 is a falling tone . Below is a figure showing the pitch pattern of this tone. Click the CONTINUE button to hear two examples of Tone 4 carried by syllable ma. We are using falling (\) to describe the phonetic feature of the tone. Please listen carefully to the syllable and try to identify the tone to continue. There will be feedback about your answer.

This pre-test will have 36 trials. Please listen carefully to the syllable and try to identify the tone to continue. There will be no feedback about your answer.


You will receive a bonus of $.01 for each correct answer.


The tones are carried by three syllables from the nine syllables (ma, mo, ya, yi, shu, wei, xue, yuan, and sheng). There will be a learning session after this pre-test so that you can learn the tones.

This learning session will have 350 trials. Please listen carefully to the syllable and try to identify the tone to continue. There will be feedback about your answer.


If you are correct , the feedback will be just one second .


If you are wrong , the system will replay the tone sound and show the correct answer. The feedback will last for 6 seconds so that you have enough time to learn from it. Please do your best to learn from the feedback .


You will receive a bonus of $.01 for each correct answer.


The tones are carried by six syllables from the nine syllables (ma, mo, ya, yi, shu, wei, xue, yuan, and sheng). After this learning session, you will take a post-test.

This post-test will have 36 trials. Please listen carefully to the syllable and try to identify the tone to continue. There will be no feedback about your answer.


You will receive a bonus of $.01 for each correct answer.


The tones are carried by three syllables from the nine syllables (ma, mo, ya, yi, shu, wei, xue, yuan, and sheng). There will be a short survey after this post-test.
